display.purpose: Bundled public DM Sans 700; root PageHeading at 25sp.

headline.purpose: Explicit 40sp/46sp Settings title in bundled DM Sans bold; quick setup uses its separate Material headlineLarge role.

title.purpose: DM Sans bold at 20sp for detail/back PageHeading; Material section and action title roles remain distinct.

body.purpose: Public DM Sans regular mapped to bodyLarge/bodyMedium; Material dimensions retained.

label.purpose: 12sp/16sp fixed-slot labels, selected bold and inactive regular; width-aware scale-down.

shadows.name: navigation-native-elevation
shadows.purpose: Ui.kt graphicsLayer shadowElevation on shell material only, 6dp at rest and at most 9dp; native elevation is not a measured CSS shadow.

motion.name: navigation-selection-duration
motion.purpose: Shared animateDpAsState selection with FastOutSlowInEasing; native selection transition.

motion.name: navigation-response-duration
motion.purpose: Shell animateFloatAsState response uses FastOutSlowInEasing. Icon tween uses Compose default easing.

motion.name: navigation-response-easing
motion.purpose: Compose FastOutSlowInEasing for shared selection and shell response.

motion.name: navigation-icon-scale
motion.purpose: Selected 26dp icon scales independently; fixed tab hit areas and labels do not shift.

motion.name: navigation-shell-scroll-response
motion.purpose: Root user scroll energy = clamp(previous - consumed.y / 160, -1, 1). Only shell material and its selected surface transform; anchor and touch row stay fixed.

motion.name: navigation-settle-delay
motion.purpose: MainActivity.kt LaunchedEffect(scrollEnergy, tab) resets energy after this delay; the shell settles through the response tween.

motion.name: navigation-system-animation-policy
motion.purpose: Scroll-energy updates are gated by Android animator enablement; Compose state animations follow system scaling. Implementation evidence does not establish TalkBack or complete reduced-motion verification.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Theme-aware native PrimaryAction: 52dp minimum, 8dp corners. Dark and light previews approximate native Material state layers; panel fonts depend on DM Sans availability.

components.name: Outlined action
components.description: Native subordinate outlined action. Warmup is a 48dp-minimum logger action; native Material capsule geometry is represented for the panel.

components.name: Text action
components.description: Subordinate native action. Logger Guide opens original guidance in a sheet above the current set; this button-only preview approximates Material state layers.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Capsule outlined search. The workout picker places it below the heading with Done and optional filters, with IME padding on the viewport. Root Exercises keeps its separate bottom overlay. Public DM Sans is bundled in the Android app; this panel is illustrative.

components.name: Metric field
components.description: Native outlined numeric metric, 10dp corners, centered values, numeric keyboard and validation semantics. Weight/reps are the quick-start path for compatible exercises; other metrics remain exercise-dependent.

components.name: Selected filter chip
components.description: Selected native exercise chip in the logger: 48dp minimum height and 240dp maximum width. General library filters retain native Material sizing. Preview illustrates the logger role.

components.name: Tonal card
components.description: Flat 16dp-radius container for templates, the visible active program and retained analytics/history. Current logger selected-exercise content sits on the page background, with a photo and Guide action.

components.name: Floating navigation
components.description: Five-slot navigation capsule with Workout selected and central Start or resume workout action. The root content continues behind it. Native tabs and touch targets stay fixed while shell material responds to scroll; the panel approximates appearance and focus states only.
components.css: .ds-nav{max-width:480px;background:transparent}.ds-nav-material{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(#1C1C1E,#1C1C1E) padding-box,linear-gradient(#9B786E,#2E2929) border-box;pointer-events:none}.ds-nav-track{height:66px;position:relative;display:flex;padding:0 4px}.ds-nav-selection{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;width:calc((100% - 8px)/5);height:58px;border-radius:999px;background:#393939;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-nav-track button{font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;z-index:1;flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#A1A4AA;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav-track svg{fill:#92969C;transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-nav-track button[aria-selected="true"]{color:#fff;font-weight:700}.ds-nav-track button[aria-selected="true"] svg{fill:#fff;transform:scale(1.04)}.ds-nav-track .ds-nav-add{align-self:center;flex:0 0 48px;height:48px;margin:0 calc(((100% - 8px)/5 - 48px)/2);background:#fff}.ds-nav-track .ds-nav-add svg{fill:#000}.ds-nav-track button:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}.ds-nav-track button:active{filter:brightness(.85)}.ds-nav-track button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:-2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-selection,.ds-nav-track svg{transition:none}}

components.name: Grouped Settings rows
components.description: Grouped Settings rows with title-only content, monochrome 40dp icon wells and inset separators. Dark treatment shown; light uses theme surfaces. Native rows expose button semantics.

narrative.overview:
Open Factor makes meaningful training features easy to use. The current direction pairs a quiet charcoal logger with original exercise photos, videos, instructions and anatomy. Guidance is directly reachable from discovery and the active set; it is a core capability rather than decoration. Start on Workout, choose an exercise, view its guide when needed, enter weight and reps, add warmups and finish into history. Page and section titles stand alone without explanatory captions.

The floating navigation and grouped Settings remain part of the existing system. Programs, body data, analytics and advanced logging remain available; the active program is visible on Workout and the default journey stays short. The current direction at the top of [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) and the [workouts contract](.impeccable/surfaces/workouts.md) supersedes the older MacroFactor parity brief. Historical parity differences are not release blockers for this direction.

**Key characteristics:**

- Charcoal tonal grouping, white foreground and restrained completion/error colors.
- Publicly bundled DM Sans, native Compose controls and scalable type.
- Original media, selectable human anatomy, compact exercise chips and visible Finish.
- Device-local training, bundled static guidance, explicit HTTPS video playback and a bounded cache.

This refresh inspects the native source, including `ExerciseMedia.kt`, `ExerciseAnatomy.kt`, video-source/cache code, build-mode staging and the [media packaging contract](docs/open-factor/MEDIA-PACKAGING.md). Prior `inspection/release-evidence/` screenshots and 0.2.0 checks describe their captured checkpoint; they do not establish verification of the corrected 0.3.0 guidance/media flow. This documentation pass did not run builds or device automation, certify a deployed service, or run an HTML/CSS detector on the native app. Final release evidence belongs to its explicit artifact and test scope. Physical-device performance, TalkBack operation and tablets remain uncertified here.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal tonal grouping, white foreground and restrained completion/error colors.
Publicly bundled DM Sans, native Compose controls and scalable type.
Original guidance and selectable anatomy directly accessible from discovery and the current set.
Device-local training, bundled static media and explicit HTTPS video playback with a 128 MiB cache.

rules.name: Theme foreground
rules.body: Use theme primary and onPrimary together; light mode uses charcoal actions with white text.

rules.name: Public typography
rules.body: Use bundled public DM Sans for mapped roles and display headings; private reference fonts do not define current typography.

rules.name: Scoped depth
rules.body: Use tonal ordinary surfaces and keep the warm gradient rim and native elevated shell scoped to navigation.

dos: keep the default journey focused on exercise selection, set entry, warmups and finishing.
pair theme primary and on-primary colors and use the bundled public DM Sans.
preserve visible Finish, top picker search, compact exercise chips and native IME handling.
retain system insets, scroll end clearance, labeled actions and durable session state.
keep original guidance prominent, keep active programs visible, and scope media coverage and build modes accurately.
donts: add explanatory captions beneath page or section titles.
spread the navigation rim gradient or Settings-specific palette across logging content.
restore exact MacroFactor parity as the current release criterion.
replace the intended original guidance with generic icons or confuse source-only fallback with a full content pack.
infer TalkBack, physical performance, tablet or universal large-font certification from source or screenshots.
